step1_figure.circuit_type: MOSFET differential amplifier with diode-connected load (M3) and triode-load (M4)
step1_figure.description: A differential pair (M1, M2) biased by a 40 uA tail current source with an active diode-connected PMOS load (M3) on the left branch and a triode-region PMOS load (M4) with grounded gate on the right branch.

v_gs_nmos.description: DC gate-to-source voltage of input NMOS transistors M1 and M2

equation.formula: VGS = sqrt(2 * ID / (KPn * W / L)) + VTHN
equation.explanation: DC gate-to-source voltage required to support the tail branch bias current ID = Ibias / 2 in saturation.
equation.assumptions: M1 and M2 match, are in saturation, and channel-length modulation is neglected.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Body effect on NMOS with source at ~0.3 V increases Vth slightly in actual silicon.

v_s12_dc.description: DC potential at the coupled source node vs12 of M1 and M2

equation.explanation: The coupled source node rests at the gate bias minus the gate-to-source drop.
equation.assumptions: Both inputs VG1 and VG2 are biased at 0.9 V DC.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by gate common-mode voltage minus NMOS Vgs.

v_sg3_dc.description: DC source-to-gate voltage of diode-connected PMOS load M3

equation.explanation: Diode-connected PMOS operating in saturation carrying ID = 20 uA.
equation.assumptions: M3 operates in saturation because VDG = 0.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard square-law saturation drop for PMOS diode load.

v_d13_dc.description: DC drain potential at node vd13 (drain of M1 / M3)

equation.explanation: DC output voltage at the diode-connected branch.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Output node sits one PMOS diode drop below VDD.

r_ch_m4.description: Small-signal channel resistance of PMOS transistor M4 operating in deep triode

equation.explanation: PMOS triode-region channel resistance when gate is tied to ground (VSG = VDD) and VSD is very small.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Deep triode channel resistance with 1.38 V overdrive.

v_d24_dc.description: DC drain potential at node vd24 (drain of M2 / M4)

equation.explanation: DC drop across triode PMOS resistor M4 carrying 20 uA.
equation.assumptions: VSD is very small (~tens of mV).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Because M4 has a strong gate overdrive of 1.38 V, VSD is minimal and VD24 is very close to VDD.
Direct square-root dependence on ID and W/L.

gm3.description: Transconductance of diode-connected load PMOS M3

sky130_expected.reasoning: Sets the small-signal resistance 1/gm3 of the left load branch.

v_s12_ac.description: AC small-signal voltage amplitude at coupled source node vs12 for vin = 1 mV

equation.explanation: For symmetric differential pair driven single-endedly with vin on gate 1 and gate 2 grounded AC, the source moves by vin/2.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Half of the single-ended input drops across the source follower action of M1.

v_d13_ac.description: AC small-signal voltage magnitude at node vd13 for vin = 1 mV

equation.explanation: AC voltage developed across the diode load 1/gm3 by small-signal current id1 = gm1 * (vin/2).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain from input to vd13 is gm1 / (2 * gm3).

v_d24_ac.description: AC small-signal voltage magnitude at node vd24 for vin = 1 mV

equation.explanation: AC voltage developed across the triode resistance Rch_M4 by small-signal current id2 = -gm1 * (vin/2).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain from input to vd24 is gm1 * Rch_M4 / 2.

step3_testbench.description: Operating point and AC analysis testbench verifying DC bias points, small-signal channel resistance, and AC gains of Example 9.5 on Sky130.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Example 9.5 Differential Circuit (Baker Ch. 9)
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=10u L_xm1=2u
.param W_xm2=10u L_xm2=2u
.param W_xm3=30u L_xm3=2u
.param W_xm4=30u L_xm4=2u

xm2 vd24 N001 vs12 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
VDD VDD 0 1.8
Ibias vs12 0 40u
xm1 vd13 vg1 vs12 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm4 vd24 0 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm3 vd13 vd13 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
VG1 vg1 0 DC 0.9 AC 1m
VG2 N001 0 0.9

.control
run
op

* DC Operating Point Measurements
let v_s12_dc = v(vs12)
let v_gs_nmos = v(vg1) - v(vs12)
let v_d13_dc = v(vd13)
let v_sg3_dc = v(vdd) - v(vd13)
let v_d24_dc = v(vd24)
let v_sd4_dc = v(vdd) - v(vd24)
* Current through M4 equals drain current of M2
let id4 = 20u
let r_ch_m4 = v_sd4_dc / id4

print v_s12_dc v_gs_nmos v_d13_dc v_sg3_dc v_d24_dc r_ch_m4

* AC Small-Signal Analysis
ac dec 100 1 10k

meas ac v_s12_ac find v(vs12) at=1k
meas ac v_d13_ac find v(vd13) at=1k
meas ac v_d24_ac find v(vd24) at=1k

let gm1_meas = (2 * v_d13_ac / 1m) * (v_d13_ac / (v_d13_ac / 173u))
print v_s12_ac v_d13_ac v_d24_ac

quit
.endc
.end
